entries.complaint: The glossary explicitly warns not to conflate 'junction' with the generic graph-theory 'node', but lib/lang.ec.it.php already renders every existing 'Junction' string (lpn_tool_add_junction, lpn_mode_add_junction, and about 30 others) as 'Nodo' -- the same word this file also uses for the generic node concept in tips and error messages. I kept 'Nodo' for the new lpn_ff_col_junction to stay consistent with the file's own established convention (sibling-key parallelism), but that convention itself conflicts with the glossary's junction/node distinction. A full pass introducing a distinct Italian word for 'junction' (e.g. 'Giunzione' or similar) versus generic 'node' would touch dozens of existing keys and is out of scope for a resync sprint that touches only 320 keys.
readings: Keep 'Nodo' for junction everywhere, matching this file's long-standing convention (chosen)
Introduce a separate Italian term for 'junction' distinct from generic 'node', which would require a wider consistency pass beyond this sprint's scope
